messages:
Priya (docs): heads up  Found a cluster of internal runbook images that 403 when served from the staging CDN. Quick ask: who can take ownership of rehosting and a tiny frontmatter flag `custodian:` so folks know who to ping?
Noah (storage): I can own rehosting for storage-related guides. Which files exactly?
Priya (docs): preliminary list from InfraBot: 
- docs/runbooks/txn-recovery.md -> https://staging.cdn.redwood.local/images/txn-flow.png
- docs/runbooks/kv-cache-ops.md -> https://staging.cdn.redwood.local/images/kv-diag@2x.png
- docs/runbooks/diagnostics/latency-troubleshoot.md -> https://staging.cdn.redwood.local/images/latency-timeline.svg
InfraBot: asset-scan 6150 results: 8 staging 403s, 2 prod 403s. Details: https://internal/reports/asset-scan/6150
Marta (eng): hit txn-recovery last week in an oncall. I can temp-own that doc while we rehost.
Lena (platform): Storage team rehosts are fine but we should instead centralize doc assets into the CDN bucket `docs-assets.redwood` and update links. That avoids per-file fixes.
Priya (docs): Agreed. Proposal:
- short term: add frontmatter `custodian: <name>` to each affected MD and rehost images for those files; open a PR per file.
- medium term: single migration script to rewrite markdown image URLs to `https://cdn.redwood.ai/docs-assets/...` and upload missing assets.
Noah (storage): For the short term Ill rehost txn-recovery and latency-troubleshoot. @Marta can you take kv-cache-ops?
Marta (eng): yep, claiming kv-cache-ops. Will add `custodian: Marta (eng)` and run a smoke curl test.
Priya (docs): Minimal PR checklist (please include these in PR description):
- custodian: NAME
- rehost evidence: link to uploaded asset (internal S3 path)
- smoke test command: `curl -I <image-url>` -> 200
- CI: run `docs/build` to ensure no broken links
CI Bot: docs/build passed on 6149999000 for earlier PRs.
Lena (platform): For the migration script I can put together a small lambda + GH Actions job. Filing ticket PLAT-312 (will link in PR).
Priya (docs): here's a tiny awk/sed pair to extract and rewrite staging URLs into a CSV to help batch upload: 
```
rg "https://staging.cdn.redwood.local/[^)\"]+" docs | sed -E "s/:/\\t/" | awk '{print $1","$2}' > image-refs.csv
```
Marta (eng): PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2010 (kv-cache-ops) includes `custodian: Marta (eng)` and rehosted asset path `s3://docs-assets/kv-diag@2x.png`. Smoke test: `curl -I https://cdn.redwood.ai/docs-assets/kv-diag@2x.png` returned 200 locally. Tagging @Noah @Priya for review.
Noah (storage): will review. After merge Ill run a tiny lambda to copy image into the canonical bucket and set public-read for docs CDN.
Priya (docs): also adding a short note to the runbook template suggesting `custodian:` is required for runbooks; will open a small docs style PR.
InfraBot: nightly-scan scheduled: true (next run in 24h). Summary will be posted to #docs.
Lena (platform): filed PLAT-312 and added a CI step to flag staging-cdn URLs during lints. Ticket: https://internal/PLAT-312
Priya (docs): Thanks all 44d If anyone else sees 403 images please drop links here and we'll triage + batch.
